item.title: Sound Stage launches in Early Access for PC this October
item.description: Q4 of this year is shaping up to be huge for rhythm games. First, Stage Tour was announced by RedOctane Games, a development studio led by rhythm game veterans. Now, Sound Stage has been announced to launch in Early Access for PC this fall. And Sound Stage is also by a group of rhythm game veterans, who created the development studio Echo Foundry Interactive. item.title: Review: Path of Mystery: A Brush with Death (Nintendo Switch)
item.description: Nintendo’s decision to revive the Famicom Detective Club series seems to have kick-started a mild rush of new games that are, effectively, mystery visual novels, but have point-and-click elements and light puzzles to keep players interested and intrigued. That’s a good thing. This genre is excellent. And Aksys’ decision to localise Path of Mystery: A Brush with Death is a very welcome one. item.title: Otome visual novel 9 R.I.P. sequel is coming West for Nintendo Switch this year
item.description: Idea Factory International has announced that it will be publishing 9 R.I.P. sequel, a sequel to the otome visual novel 9 R.I.P., digitally and physically for Nintendo Switch later this year. The game features nine full routes, including direct continuations of the Heavenly and Godly Endings from 9 R.I.P. Players can unlock bonus content by navigating through the story. item.title: Pixel-perfect dungeon scroller Dark Scrolls announced for PC and Nintendo Switch
item.description: Devolver Digital and Doinksoft (Gato Roboto, Gunbrella, Demon Throttle) have announced Dark Scrolls, a pixel art dungeon scroller. The game mashes challenging shmup-like chaos and compelling roguelike progression. Players set off on a quest (but for what?) with one of the worthy yet quirky heroes, dodging through hordes of enemies and deadly traps. Each run is procedurally generated. item.title: Turn-based JRPG Starbites launches in the West for PC and consoles this May
item.description: Last August, NIS America announced it would publish Starbites in the West during early 2026; today, the publisher confirmed the release window by revealing a May 2026 launch date for the IKINAGAMES-developed sci-fi JRPG. This Western version will be available for PC, PlayStation 5, Switch 2, Switch, and Xbox Series. The game originally launched in Japan during October 2025, without a Switch 2 version. item.title: Urban Myth Dissolution Center is now available for iOS/Android devices
item.description: Publisher Shueisha Games had announced that the award-winning paranormal mystery adventure game Urban Myth Dissolution Center has been released on iOS and Android. There are two mobile-exclusive features: full touch optimization and customizable frame designs for the non-playable area of the screen. Otherwise, graphics, scenarios, and gameplay are identical to the original version. item.title: The catch-up coffee: March 23, 2026
item.description: Welcome to Digitally Downloaded’s weekly catch-up news feature, the catch-up coffee. Here, I bring you the best news you may have missed from last week. Grab the biggest mug you’ve got, fill it with your favourite brew, and catch up with us (and our favourite news anchor, Dee Dee)! LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight’s release date has changed Warner Bros. Games has announced that LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight, originally scheduled for release on May 29, will launch one week earlier.

item.title: Review: Ariana and the Elder Codex (Sony PlayStation 5)
item.description: If you were to ask me what genres I think developers should take a very long break from, most days I would respond “Metroidvania” or “Roguelike.” It’s not that I have an inherent distaste for either, but did you know that overexposure to something can result in you acquiring an allergy to it? item.title: City Town DLC for Hello Kitty Island Adventure launches this April
item.description: Sunblink and Sanrio have announced an April release date for Hello Kitty Island Adventure’s City Town DLC. Hello Kitty Island Adventure is a cozy adventure game featuring beloved Sanrio characters, and the City Town DLC brings a brand new city area to the game, leaving nature behind for the bright lights.
